policy: Every retained capital and registered project district owns one bounded terrain-owned ground transition.
Wide-area close terrain is camera-streamed; local site overlays contain only material-matched foundation contact.
Every site alpha is a subset of the registered land alpha and cannot cover the locked water layer.
The Kaizen Agent contact is the only retained NinjaOne project site in the current MVP.
Vegetation, actors, labels, and transient effects remain in their owning layers.
note: Legacy capital ground tiles retired 2026-09-05 (owner: "can you make sure old art is all gone?"): the pre-L2 capitals of Tanium, Independent, Column Technologies and ACE Hardware sat on old world positions, now the new land or open water. Capitals return with the city layer, on the L2 land.
